name: tarakhees
description: نظام متابعة التراخيص والتجديدات - Saudi license & renewal tracker

scripts.setup: npm run env:init && npm run db:up && npm run prisma:migrate && npm run prisma:seed
scripts.setup:local: npm run env:init && npm run prisma:migrate && npm run prisma:seed
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=packages/shared && npm run build --workspace=apps/api && npm run build --workspace=apps/web
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace=apps/web && npm run test --workspace=apps/api
scripts.verify: npm run verify:isolation --workspace=apps/api && npm run verify:api --workspace=apps/api
scripts.lint: npm run lint --workspace=apps/api && npm run lint --workspace=apps/web
scripts.postinstall: npm run build --workspace=packages/shared && npm run generate --workspace=packages/db
